documents.text: named after former Florida State President Doak S. Campbell . With a capacity of 15,000 that consisted of seating on both sides of the field , the Seminoles played their first game at the stadium on October 7 , 1950 against Randolph Macon . Since its opening more than seven decades ago , Doak Campbell Stadium has grown from a small facility into one of the famous football stadiums in the nation . Due to increased fan support , the stadium has been expanded many times . Expansions in 1954 , 1961 and 1970 increased the seating capacity to 40,500
